grammar_title: 虚拟语气 wish 与 if only(I wish… had done / If only…)
source: 上外版选择性必修四 Unit 4 Grammar in Use:Subjunctive Mood (wish and if only)。wish/if only + 从句表达不太可能/不可能的愿望或遗憾;时态后移(backshift)是判别关键 —— 干扰项均为时态错误(陈述语气的现在/将来/现在完成),故答案唯一。句子地道、文学经典主题。

points.point: wish + 一般过去时(对现在的遗憾/此刻的非真实愿望)
points.overview: 对现在状况的遗憾或此刻达不到的愿望,wish 后从句用一般过去时(be 多用 were);句中常有 now / so I could… 等现在线索。陈述语气的现在式/将来式/现在完成式都不能跟在 wish 之后,故只有过去式成立。

points.point: wish + 过去完成时(对过去的遗憾)
points.overview: 对过去已发生或未发生之事的遗憾,wish 后从句用过去完成时(had done / hadn't done);句中常有 last week / yesterday / before… 等过去时间线索,使一般过去时(表现在非真实)不成立,只有过去完成时正确。

points.point: wish + would/could · if only 各式
points.overview: wish + would do 表对将来变化的期盼或对当下行为的不满;wish + could do 表此刻欠缺的能力或将来的可能;if only 可替换 I wish,后接过去时(对现在)、过去完成时(对过去)或 could do。干扰项为陈述语气的 will/can/现在式/进行式,均不能跟在 wish/if only 之后。

questions.stem: "How she wishes she ____ Spanish, so she could read Neruda's poems in the original now!"
questions.explanation: 对现在的非真实愿望(此刻并不懂西班牙语),wish 后用一般过去时;现在式/将来式/现在完成式都不能跟在 wish 之后。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ the deeper meaning of this classic poem."
questions.explanation: 对当下理解力的遗憾,用一般过去时表此刻的非真实状况。

questions.stem: "He wishes he ____ enough free time to read all the great novels."
questions.explanation: 现在并没有足够时间,wish 后用一般过去时表非真实现状。

questions.stem: "I wish this ancient text ____ a little easier to read."
questions.explanation: 对现在状况的愿望,be 动词在虚拟里多用 were。

questions.stem: "She wishes she ____ near a big library full of classics."
questions.explanation: 现实是她并不住在附近,wish 后用一般过去时表非真实现状。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ a complete set of Shakespeare's plays."
questions.explanation: 对现在没有的东西表愿望,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ Italian, so I could read Dante in the original."
questions.explanation: so I could… 表明是当下的非真实愿望,用一般过去时 spoke。

questions.stem: "He wishes he ____ every line of that famous monologue by heart."
questions.explanation: 对现在记不住的遗憾,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ more about the Lake Poets and their lives."
questions.explanation: 对现在了解不足的遗憾,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "She wishes she ____ as beautifully as Su Shi once did."
questions.explanation: 对当下能力的非真实愿望,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ the patience to enjoy such long classics."
questions.explanation: 现在缺乏耐心,wish 后用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ as wise as the old fisherman in the story."
questions.explanation: 对现在的非真实愿望,be 用 were。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ poetry as much as my literature teacher does."
questions.explanation: 对当下感受的非真实愿望,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "She wishes she ____ why this old novel is called a classic."
questions.explanation: 对现在不明白的遗憾,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "We wish our teacher ____ a class on classic Chinese poems."
questions.explanation: 对现状(老师并不教这门课)的非真实愿望,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ in the age of the great Romantic poets."
questions.explanation: 与现实相反的愿望,用一般过去时表非真实。

questions.stem: "I wish everyone in my class ____ about books the way you do."
questions.explanation: 对现状的非真实愿望,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "I wish my little brother ____ reading classics as much as I do."
questions.explanation: 现实是他并不喜欢,wish 后用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "He wishes he ____ an old first edition of that famous novel."
questions.explanation: 对现在没有之物的愿望,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ as moved by poetry as my best friend is."
questions.explanation: 对当下感受的非真实愿望,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ that classic novel before the exam last week."
questions.explanation: last week 表过去,对过去未做之事的遗憾,wish 后用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "He wishes he ____ reading War and Peace before yesterday's literature quiz."
questions.explanation: yesterday 锁定过去,对过去的遗憾用过去完成时 had finished。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ up so late reading Gone with the Wind last night."
questions.explanation: last night 表过去,对昨晚行为的后悔用过去完成时的否定式。

questions.stem: "She wishes she ____ to the poetry recital yesterday evening."
questions.explanation: yesterday evening 表过去,对过去未去的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ those cruel words to my best friend an hour ago."
questions.explanation: an hour ago 表过去,对说过的话后悔,用过去完成时的否定式。

questions.stem: "He wishes he ____ the great DiMaggio play before that star retired."
questions.explanation: before that star retired 指过去,对过去错过之事的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ more attention during yesterday's lecture on Shakespeare."
questions.explanation: yesterday 表过去,对过去未做好的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "They wish they ____ the old fisherman's advice earlier in the story."
questions.explanation: earlier 指此前,对过去未做之事的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ the poem by heart for last week's competition."
questions.explanation: last week 表过去,对过去准备不足的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "She wishes she ____ the real ending before a friend spoilt it for her."
questions.explanation: before a friend spoilt it 指过去,对过去的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ that rare copy when it was still on sale last month."
questions.explanation: last month 表过去,对过去未买的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "He wishes he ____ the chance to meet the famous author years ago."
questions.explanation: years ago 表过去,对过去错过机会的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ harder when I first began learning calligraphy."
questions.explanation: when I first began 指过去起点,对过去的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "We wish we ____ the museum of classics during our trip last summer."
questions.explanation: last summer 表过去,对过去未做之事的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ my essay on Su Shi before the deadline passed."
questions.explanation: before the deadline passed 指过去,对过去未完成的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "She wishes she ____ a shorter classic for her first book report last term."
questions.explanation: last term 表过去,对过去选择的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ the teacher when she explained that difficult verse yesterday."
questions.explanation: yesterday 表过去,对过去未问的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "He wishes he ____ the poetry club in his very first year at school."
questions.explanation: first year(已过去)指过去,对过去未做的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ that line correctly during last night's recitation contest."
questions.explanation: last night 表过去,对过去表现的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "They wish they ____ the play when it was first performed long ago."
questions.explanation: when it was first performed long ago 指过去,对过去错过的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I wish those noisy students ____ stop talking during the poetry reading."
questions.explanation: 对他人当下行为的不满、盼其改变,wish 后用 would do;陈述语气的 will/现在式/进行式都不能跟在 wish 之后。

questions.stem: "I wish my brother ____ read more classics instead of only comics."
questions.explanation: 盼对方将来改变习惯,用 wish + would do。

questions.stem: "I wish our teacher ____ give us a lecture on Shakespeare one day."
questions.explanation: 对将来的期盼,用 wish + would do。

questions.stem: "I wish people ____ stop spoiling the endings of famous novels."
questions.explanation: 盼他人行为改变,用 wish + would do。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ write poetry as beautifully as Wordsworth."
questions.explanation: 表此刻欠缺的能力,用 wish + could do;陈述语气的 can/will/进行式都不能跟在 wish 之后。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ recite the whole monologue without a single mistake."
questions.explanation: 表当下做不到的能力,用 wish + could do。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ meet my favourite novelist in person some day."
questions.explanation: 表难以实现的将来愿望,用 wish + could do。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ understand classical Chinese poems more easily."
questions.explanation: 表当下欠缺的能力,用 wish + could do。

questions.stem: "If only I ____ play the guzheng like the girl in the contest!"
questions.explanation: if only 表强烈愿望、能力当下达不到,用 could do。

questions.stem: "If only I ____ travel back to the age of the great poets!"
questions.explanation: if only 表不可能实现的愿望,用 could do。

questions.stem: "If only this difficult classic ____ a little shorter!"
questions.explanation: if only 对现在状况的非真实愿望,be 用 were。

questions.stem: "If only I ____ more free time to read for pleasure!"
questions.explanation: if only 对现在的非真实愿望,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "If only my handwriting ____ as neat as a calligrapher's!"
questions.explanation: if only 对现在状况的非真实愿望,be 用 were。

questions.stem: "If only I ____ such a cruel thing to her yesterday!"
questions.explanation: yesterday 表过去,if only 对过去的后悔用过去完成时的否定式。

questions.stem: "If only I ____ the whole novel before watching the film last night!"
questions.explanation: last night 表过去,if only 对过去的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "If only I ____ to the recital before it ended yesterday evening!"
questions.explanation: yesterday evening 表过去,if only 对过去的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "If only I ____ harder for last week's literature exam!"
questions.explanation: last week 表过去,if only 对过去的遗憾用过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I wish my old computer ____ open these poetry files a bit faster."
questions.explanation: 盼其行为改变,用 wish + would do。

questions.stem: "I wish I ____ remember every line of my favourite sonnet."
questions.explanation: 表当下达不到的能力,用 wish + could do。

questions.stem: "I wish the library ____ stay open later during exam week."
questions.explanation: 盼将来情况改变,用 wish + would do。
